name: Bazil Thredd
summary: In the eastern cell block, Bazil Thredd leads the Defias inmates in revolt. Edwin VanCleef's lieutenant has been held in the Stormwind Stockade since the Stonemasons' riots.

sections.title: VanCleef's Lieutenant
sections.body:
Bazil Thredd stood beside Edwin VanCleef when the Stonemasons Guild rose against Stormwind's nobility. The guild had been denied payment for rebuilding the city, and VanCleef rejected the government's attempts to appease them. Open revolt followed.

Thredd served as his chief lieutenant and most trusted assistant. The city guard captured Thredd in the clashes that followed. VanCleef and the surviving masons fled to Westfall and formed the Defias Brotherhood. Thredd was sent to the Stormwind Stockade.

sections.title: The Stockade Uprising
sections.body: A prison riot has overwhelmed the guards and opened the cells. Now the Stockade is an armed fortress beneath the Mage Quarter. Thredd commands the imprisoned Defias bandits, insurgents, and allied cutthroats from a post in the eastern wing. An ogre named Hamhock guards him. For years Thredd stayed silent behind bars, seemingly forsaken. Now Warden Thelwater wants him dead, hoping to break the rebellion's leadership before the chaos reaches the city streets.

sections.title: The Curious Visitor
sections.body: A man calling himself Maelik began visiting Bazil Thredd once or twice a week, a few months before the uprising. Warden Thelwater had long believed the Brotherhood abandoned Thredd to rot, so the visits made him suspicious. Yet Maelik's papers proved entirely legitimate. Thelwater doubts the visitor will return now that Thredd is dead. Anyone carrying papers that good is well connected. The visits suggest that outside hands in the city had reached the Defias lieutenant.

faq.answer: Bazil Thredd was Edwin VanCleef's right hand during the Stonemasons' rebellion in Stormwind. Captured in the riots and imprisoned in the Stockade, he now leads the mutinous inmates.

faq.q: Where can Bazil Thredd be found?
faq.answer: Bazil Thredd is deep inside the Stormwind Stockade, beneath the Canal District near the Mage Quarter. From the main hallway intersection, take the eastern cell block and pass the ogre Hamhock. Thredd commands from the center cell in the far chamber.

The inmates have overpowered the guards, opened the cells, and taken the Stockade's halls. Bazil Thredd commands the rioting bandits and convicts. Warden Thelwater tries to keep the revolt from reaching Stormwind's streets.

faq.q: Why does Warden Thelwater want Thredd dead?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater believes the uprising cannot be quelled while Thredd directs it. With the guards overwhelmed and inmates holding the complex, he orders Thredd executed to break the rebellion's command.

faq.q: Who was visiting Thredd before the riot?
faq.answer: A quiet man calling himself Maelik visited Thredd once or twice a week in the months before the uprising. Thelwater distrusted him, but his papers were legitimate. They suggest well connected hands in the city had reached the Defias lieutenant.

faq.q: What was Thredd's role in the Stonemasons Guild?
faq.answer: Thredd was Edwin VanCleef's principal lieutenant during Stormwind's rebuilding and the labor disputes that followed. He helped lead the guild's resistance after the House of Nobles refused to pay for their work.

angles.text: A Defias revolt beneath Stormwind's streets threatens the capital. Warden Thelwater wants its leader dealt with before it spreads.
As a human, you face a living reminder of the Stonemasons' riots that set the Defias Brotherhood against the kingdom.
